reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter flows through regex validation (^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$) and resolves to the table name in SQL concatenation at line 25. While the regex restricts special chars, it still permits alphanumeric table names that attackers can enumerate/discover in the database, enabling unauthorized data access.
